Glioblastoma; Advanced high grade epithelial ovarian cancer

candidate_evidence.quote: Blood and tumor samples: Longitudinal molecular profiling of tumor and liquid biopsies.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL) in the relapsed setting

source_quote.quote: BRAF- V600E tumors (lung and thyroid cancer) : treatment by Dabrafenib + trametinib
For MSI-High, any tumor types : treatment by Immunotherapy
All solid tumor types with ret fusion / mutation : treatment by Selpercatinib

coder_notes: Observational-type profiling programme; the only registered intervention is a biological sample collection, no study drug. Standard treatments (imatinib, dabrafenib, selpercatinib, immunotherapy, radiochemotherapy) are cohort descriptors, not registered interventions, so no agents listed. Biomarker cohorts do not apply to the glioblastoma cohort.
